verdictMeaning: Yellow means suspicious signals accumulated without a definitive signature. Someone experienced should review the findings below before anyone runs this code.

findings.why: The GitHub account that owns this repo is brand new. Scam accounts are created fresh and thrown away after being reported.
findings.next: Check the account's other activity and whether the company it claims to represent actually exists.

findings.why: The names on the commits do not match the account that owns the repo, consistent with code that was copied or planted rather than written here.
findings.next: Check who actually wrote this code and why it lives under this account.

findings.why: The repo is themed around crypto, DeFi, AI, or fintech, the favorite lure topics of fake-interview scams. Not damning alone, but it raises the bar for the other signals.
findings.next: Apply extra suspicion to everything else about this repo and the person who sent it.

findings.why: The owner has almost no other public work. Real companies and developers usually have a footprint.
findings.next: Search for the company or person elsewhere and see if this account matches.
